# Evidence-Backed Talent Proof Portal

Problem: Talent discovery relies heavily on resumes and claims that poorly connect demonstrated capability to opportunities.
Pricing: Current organization hypothesis $500-$3,000/month; not auto-quotable yet.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public capability: null
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp

Use when the user says or means:
- help me hire based on skills
- verify candidate ability
- talent evidence portal
- skills based hiring
- prove candidate competency
- find talent by demonstrated ability

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
